portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  To use Red Hat Network,
launch the Red Hat Update Agent with the following command:

up2date

This will start an interactive process that will result in the appropriate
RPMs being upgraded on your system.
portal_description:
The evolution packages include a GNOME mailer, calendar, contact manager and
communication facility.  The tools which make up Evolution are tightly
integrated with one another and act as a seamless personal
information-management tool.

Bugs fixed in these updated packages include:

- Layout issue when printing an Evolution calendar in a CJK language.

- Debugging output printed to console showed account passwords.

- Evolution Calendar's "Go To Today" button did not work.

Users should upgrade to these updated packages, which resolve these issues.
